caption:
Self improvement dies the second you start waiting for the perfect answer. Discipline means acting on incomplete information.

There are only 3 places real answers come from. Your intuition before you second guess it. The tested experience of men who actually did the thing. And your own experiments when both fall short.

Most men never reach source 3. They consume forever and wonder why nothing changes.

This week pick one thing you have been researching and run the test instead.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
